title.zh: UE5 自适应分层音乐系统

summary.zh: 在 UE5 中将同一段音乐按乐器拆分为多个声部层，并通过玩家与不同环境的互动逐步叠加声部，最终组合成完整音乐。
summary.en: An Unreal Engine 5 system that separates one composition into instrument layers and adds them through environmental interactions until the complete arrangement emerges.

zh: 让环境互动直接改变音乐编排
用逐层丰富的音乐反馈表现玩家的探索进展
en: Make environmental interactions directly alter the musical arrangement
Represent exploration progress through increasingly rich musical feedback

zh: 同一段音乐按乐器分层
环境互动触发不同乐器层
多个声部逐步叠加为完整音乐
en: One composition separated into instrument layers
Environmental interactions trigger different instrument layers
Multiple stems accumulate into the complete arrangement

zh: 在 UE5 中独立实现分层音乐交互系统，将同一段音乐拆分为多个乐器声部，并由环境互动控制声部叠加。
设计由单一声部逐步组合为完整音乐的反馈过程，使玩家的环境探索能够被即时听觉变化感知。
en: Independently implemented a layered music interaction system in UE5, separating one composition into instrument stems controlled by environmental interactions.
Designed an audible progression from individual stems to a complete arrangement so environmental exploration produces immediate musical feedback.

website.zh: 这是一个独立完成的 UE5 音乐编程原型。玩家与不同环境互动时会加入对应的乐器层，使音乐从单一声部逐渐发展为完整编排。
website.en: An independently developed UE5 music-programming prototype in which environmental interactions add instrument layers, gradually transforming a sparse track into a complete arrangement.

full.zh: 项目探索音乐与环境交互之间的直接映射：同一段音乐被拆分为多个乐器声部，玩家触发不同环境元素时，相应声部加入并与已有声部同步叠加，最终组合成完整音乐。
full.en: The project explores a direct mapping between music and environmental interaction. One composition is separated into instrument stems; as the player triggers different environmental elements, corresponding stems join the synchronized mix until the full arrangement is formed.
